text: For God loved the world in this way: He gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.
But God proves his own love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
The LORD your God is among you, a warrior who saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness. He will be quiet in his love. He will delight in you with singing.”
the LORD appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore, I have continued to extend faithful love to you.
For you are saved by grace through faith, and this is not from yourselves; it is God’s gift—
For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
he saved us—not by works of righteousness that we had done, but according to his mercy—through the washing of regeneration and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God;
We all went astray like sheep; we all have turned to our own way; and the LORD has punished him for the iniquity of us all.
There is certainly no one righteous on the earth who does good and never sins.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
“Come, let’s settle this,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are crimson red, they will be like wool.
Who is a God like you, forgiving iniquity and passing over rebellion for the remnant of his inheritance? He does not hold on to his anger forever because he delights in faithful love.
And be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving one another, just as God also forgave you in Christ.
bearing with one another and forgiving one another if anyone has a grievance against another. Just as the Lord has forgiven you, so you are also to forgive.
“For if you forgive others their offenses, your heavenly Father will forgive you as well.
“Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, because they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided his clothes and cast lots.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will help you; I will hold on to you with my righteous right hand.
Even when I go through the darkest valley, I fear no danger, for you are with me; your rod and your staff—they comfort me.
Now this is what the LORD says—the one who created you, Jacob, and the one who formed you, Israel—“Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are mine.
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but one of power, love, and sound judgment.
Haven’t I commanded you: be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
The LORD is my shepherd; I have what I need.
“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
He protects his flock like a shepherd; he gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them in the fold of his garment. He gently leads those that are nursing.
Acknowledge that the LORD is God. He made us, and we are his—his people, the sheep of his pasture.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not rely on your own understanding;
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him, and he will act,
Some take pride in chariots, and others in horses, but we take pride in the name of the LORD our God.
The person who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence indeed is the LORD, is blessed.
Those who know your name trust in you because you have not abandoned those who seek you, LORD.
I am able to do all things through him who strengthens me.
but those who trust in the LORD will renew their strength; they will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not become weary, they will walk and not faint.

Then he said to them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, because the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
God is our refuge and strength, a helper who is always found in times of trouble.

But he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore, I will most gladly boast all the more about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may reside in me.
“Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Don’t let your heart be troubled or fearful.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
You will keep the mind that is dependent on you in perfect peace, for it is trusting in you.
Therefore, since we have been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
I have told you these things so that in me you may have peace. You will have suffering in this world. Be courageous! I have conquered the world.”
Don’t worry about anything, but in everything, through prayer and petition with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
Therefore don’t worry about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
casting all your cares on him, because he cares about you.
Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never allow the righteous to be shaken.
But when you pray, go into your private room, shut your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
“Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened to you.
Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is very powerful in its effect.
Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and incomprehensible things you do not know.
Now faith is the reality of what is hoped for, the proof of what is not seen.
Now without faith it is impossible to please God, since the one who draws near to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
So faith comes from what is heard, and what is heard comes through the message about Christ.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
For I know the plans I have for you”—this is the LORD’s declaration—“plans for your well-being, not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope.
We know that all things work together for the good of those who love God, who are called according to his purpose.
Why, my soul, are you so dejected? Why are you in such turmoil? Put your hope in God, for I will still praise him, my Savior and my God.
Rejoice in hope; be patient in affliction; be persistent in prayer.
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
All Scripture is inspired by God and is profitable for teaching, for rebuking, for correcting, for training in righteousness,

For the word of God is living and effective and sharper than any double-edged sword, penetrating as far as the separation of soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It is able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
The grass withers, the flowers fade, but the word of our God remains forever.”
I have treasured your word in my heart so that I may not sin against you.

This book of instruction must not depart from your mouth; you are to meditate on it day and night so that you may carefully observe everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in whatever you do.
But be doers of the word and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
These words that I am giving you today are to be in your heart.
“I give you a new command: Love one another. Just as I have loved you, you are also to love one another.
Dear friends, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Love one another deeply as brothers and sisters. Take the lead in honoring one another.
Above all, maintain constant love for one another, since love covers a multitude of sins.
Love is patient, love is kind. Love does not envy, is not boastful, is not arrogant,
Now these three remain: faith, hope, and love—but the greatest of these is love.
Little children, let us not love in word or speech, but in action and in truth.
He said to him, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.
We love because he first loved us.
For this is what love for God is: to keep his commands. And his commands are not a burden,
Therefore, whatever you want others to do for you, do also the same for them, for this is the Law and the Prophets.
For the whole law is fulfilled in one statement: Love your neighbor as yourself.
Love does no wrong to a neighbor. Love, therefore, is the fulfillment of the law.
Jesus told him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me, even if he dies, will live.
Jesus spoke to them again: “I am the light of the world. Anyone who follows me will never walk in the darkness but will have the light of life.”
“I am the bread of life,” Jesus told them. “No one who comes to me will ever be hungry, and no one who believes in me will ever be thirsty again.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The Word became flesh and dwelt among us. We observed his glory, the glory as the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
For the Son of Man has come to seek and to save the lost.”
This saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners”—and I am the worst of them.
A thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come so that they may have life and have it in abundance.
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Today in the city of David a Savior was born for you, who is the Messiah, the Lord.
But he was pierced because of our rebellion, crushed because of our iniquities; punishment for our peace was on him, and we are healed by his wounds.
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree; so that, having died to sins, we might live for righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.
He made the one who did not know sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
For I passed on to you as most important what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
He is not here. For he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
But as it is, Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
Therefore we were buried with him by baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, so we too may walk in newness of life.
Where, death, is your victory? Where, death, is your sting?
Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has passed away, and see, the new has come!
I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
Do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may discern what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
Jesus replied, “Truly I tell you, unless someone is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”
But to all who did receive him, he gave them the right to be children of God, to those who believe in his name,
See what great love the Father has given us that we should be called God’s children—and we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it didn’t know him.
But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come on you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and remind you of everything I have told you.
In the same way the Spirit also helps us in our weakness, because we do not know what to pray for as we should, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with inexpressible groanings.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
Don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness!
Know that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps his gracious covenant loyalty for a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commands.
But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
Let us hold on to the confession of our hope without wavering, since he who promised is faithful.

No temptation has come upon you except what is common to humanity. But God is faithful; he will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation he will also provide the way out so that you may be able to bear it.
Keep your life free from the love of money. Be satisfied with what you have, for he himself has said, I will never leave you or abandon you.
teaching them to observe everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age.”
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and the rivers will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched, and the flame will not burn you.
The LORD will protect your coming and going both now and forever.
Be strong and courageous; don’t be terrified or afraid of them. For the LORD your God is the one who will go with you; he will not leave you or abandon you.”
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and the expanse proclaims the work of his hands.
For everything was created by him, in heaven and on earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things have been created through him and for him.
The earth and everything in it, the world and its inhabitants, belong to the LORD;
I will praise you because I have been remarkably and wondrously made. Your works are wondrous, and I know this very well.
So God created man in his own image; he created him in the image of God; he created them male and female.
what is a human being that you remember him, a son of man that you look after him?
I chose you before I formed you in the womb; I set you apart before you were born. I appointed you a prophet to the nations.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared ahead of time for us to do.
Our Lord is great, vast in power; his understanding is infinite.

For the eyes of the LORD roam throughout the earth to show himself strong for those who are wholeheartedly devoted to him. You have been foolish in this matter. Therefore, you will have wars from now on.”

But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not look at his appearance or his stature because I have rejected him. Humans do not see what the LORD sees, for humans see what is visible, but the LORD sees the heart.”
Where can I go to escape your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?
Oh, Lord GOD! You yourself made the heavens and earth by your great power and with your outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for you!
Jesus said to him, “‘If you can’? Everything is possible for the one who believes.”
Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
Is anything impossible for the LORD? At the appointed time I will come back to you, and in about a year she will have a son.”
Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Hallelujah!
I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
My soul, bless the LORD, and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Therefore, through him let us continually offer up to God a sacrifice of praise, that is, the fruit of lips that confess his name.
give thanks in everything; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise. Give thanks to him and bless his name.
And whatever you do, in word or in deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
This is the day the LORD has made; let’s rejoice and be glad in it.
You reveal the path of life to me; in your presence is abundant joy; at your right hand are eternal pleasures.
For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor, a lifetime. Weeping may stay overnight, but there is joy in the morning.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you.
Do nothing out of selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility consider others as more important than yourselves.
Mankind, he has told each of you what is good and what it is the LORD requires of you: to act justly, to love faithfulness, and to walk humbly with your God.
Pride comes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God—who gives to all generously and ungrudgingly—and it will be given to him.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.
Wisdom is supreme—so get wisdom. And whatever else you get, get understanding.
Teach us to number our days carefully so that we may develop wisdom in our hearts.
A gentle answer turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs up wrath.
My dear brothers and sisters, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
No foul language should come from your mouth, but only what is good for building up someone in need, so that it gives grace to those who hear.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to you, LORD, my rock and my Redeemer.
Be angry and do not sin. Don’t let the sun go down on your anger,
Patience is better than power, and controlling one’s emotions, than capturing a city.
Don’t let your spirit rush to be angry, for anger abides in the heart of fools.
Let us not get tired of doing good, for we will reap at the proper time if we don’t give up.
Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, be steadfast, immovable, always excelling in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
When it is in your power, don’t withhold good from the one to whom it belongs.
In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
Each person should do as he has decided in his heart—not reluctantly or out of compulsion, since God loves a cheerful giver.
In every way I’ve shown you that it is necessary to help the weak by laboring like this and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, because he said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
Give, and it will be given to you; a good measure—pressed down, shaken together, and running over—will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
A generous person will be enriched, and the one who gives a drink of water will receive water.

Bring the full tenth into the storehouse so that there may be food in my house. Test me in this way,” says the LORD of Armies. “See if I will not open the floodgates of heaven and pour out a blessing for you without measure.
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and by craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.
For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
For what will it benefit someone if he gains the whole world yet loses his life? Or what will anyone give in exchange for his life?
A good name is to be chosen over great wealth; favor is better than silver and gold.
Whatever you do, do it from the heart, as something done for the Lord and not for people,
There is profit in all hard work, but endless talk leads only to poverty.
In fact, when we were with you, this is what we commanded you: “If anyone isn’t willing to work, he should not eat.”
Whatever your hands find to do, do with all your strength, because there is no work, planning, knowledge, or wisdom in Sheol where you are going.
Honor your father and your mother so that you may have a long life in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and don’t reject your mother’s teaching,
A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a difficult time.
One with many friends may be harmed, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
No one has greater love than this: to lay down his life for his friends.
Two are better than one because they have a good reward for their efforts.
How delightfully good when brothers live together in harmony!
making every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree in what you say, that there be no divisions among you, and that you be united with the same understanding and the same conviction.
May they all be one, as you, Father, are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us, so that the world may believe you sent me.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD shines over you.
“You are the light of the world. A city situated on a hill cannot be hidden.
The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom should I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom should I dread?
This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light, and there is absolutely no darkness in him.
That light shines in the darkness, and yet the darkness did not overcome it.
Go, therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
Then he said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, and also to the Greek.
but in your hearts regard Christ the Lord as holy, ready at any time to give a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you.
for it is written, Be holy, because I am holy.
Therefore, brothers and sisters, in view of the mercies of God, I urge you to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God; this is your true worship.
God, create a clean heart for me and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Therefore, submit to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Be sober-minded, be alert. Your adversary the devil is prowling around like a roaring lion, looking for anyone he can devour.
Put on the full armor of God so that you can stand against the schemes of the devil.
Stay awake and pray, so that you won’t enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Be alert, stand firm in the faith, be courageous, be strong.
In my Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; grief, crying, and pain will be no more, because the previous things have passed away.
Our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly wait for a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.
But as it is written, What no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart has conceived—God has prepared these things for those who love him.
They said, “Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking up into heaven? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come in the same way that you have seen him going into heaven.”
For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the archangel’s voice, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
He who testifies about these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
This is why you are also to be ready, because the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect.
Be silent before the LORD and wait expectantly for him; do not be agitated by one who prospers in his way, by the person who carries out evil plans.
I am at rest in God alone; my salvation comes from him.
Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart be courageous. Wait for the LORD.
“Come to me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
I will both lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
And he replied, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
“Stop fighting, and know that I am God, exalted among the nations, exalted on the earth.”
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in faithful love.
Because of the LORD’s faithful love we do not perish, for his mercies never end.
Therefore, let us approach the throne of grace with boldness, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in time of need.
But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be provided for you.
You will seek me and find me when you search for me with all your heart.
and my people, who bear my name, humble themselves, pray and seek my face, and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
Seek the LORD while he may be found; call to him while he is near.
But from there, you will search for the LORD your God, and you will find him when you seek him with all your heart and all your soul.
If you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
For everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
Everyone the Father gives me will come to me, and the one who comes to me I will never cast out.
They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.”
See! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. How happy is the person who takes refuge in him!
The LORD is good to everyone; his compassion rests on all he has made.
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in a day of distress; he cares for those who take refuge in him.
Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus,
What, then, are we to say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
The LORD is for me; I will not be afraid. What can a mere mortal do to me?
